notes: Source-owned display/presentation fixture generated by fixtures/display_smoke/generate.py. The guest fills the PSP framebuffer with a shifting striped pattern and flips it through sceDisplaySetFrameBuf once per frame, so it is the first public-scope title that exercises the presentation path end to end and the first the native player can launch. Its build directory and artifact stem are deliberately this manifest's id, because src/core/nk_launch.c resolves a launch by probing build/<title_id>/<title_id>.exe. Hand-assembled MIPS from a committed recipe: no PSPDEV toolchain, no retail bytes, no derived metadata.
